verdict.rationale: Intel markets the chip as enabling Copilot+ AI-assistant experiences ('Say it and Copilot+ helps do it... Use voice commands to get answers, edit content') and full Copilot+ integration, but this is platform/OS-level assistant functionality enabled by the NPU/GPU/CPU trio, not an assistant built into the processor itself. missing for 10: evidence of actual task delegation workflows, hands-on demonstration of agentic behavior, and clarity on what is chip-specific vs. Windows/Copilot software layer.
